SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
CONFIDENTIAL
No. U 432
1-7-44
21 February 1944
Station Foreign Affairs Section File No.
SUBJECT: Dolgoff N.S., Dolgoff V.S. and Sediakin N.V.
antecedents and character.

DOLGOFF Nikolai Sergeevich, Russian emigrant,
married, born on 5.2.1900 in Samara-Russia.
He resided in Manchuria in 1920-1925. In 1925
he proceeded to Japan and resided there until 1938.
Arrived in Shanghai in 1938, and after a short
stay here in February 1939 gone to Japan again.
On 10.12.41, he arrived in Shanghai from Kobe
and took up residence at 97/Apt. 207-A, (Tel. 77940) Rte
Vallon. On 17.10.43, he moved to new address at 59 Rte
de Boisseson, and on 10.12.43. removed again to old address
at 97/207-A Rte Vallon, where he is living at present, with
his wife Mrs. Dolgoff A. and his daughter Ludmila (age-9).
At the same address also residing his elder
brother DOLGOFF Vladimir Sergeevich, (born in 1898), who
also arrived in Shanghai from Kobe sometime in 1941-1942.
According to information received, both bro-
thers, whilst in Japan, besides their business as merchants
were engaged in manipulations with U.S.A. dollars, and
were not considered as serious merchants, amongst business
circles. Inquiries so far revealed, that N.S. Dolgoff, has
no definite business in Shanghai. Police records do not
contain any reference detrimental to his character.
N.S. Dolgoff arrived from Japan with Japanese
document and not registered here with the Russian Migrants
Committee and considered as temporary visitor, although he
stays here, according to Pao-Chia registration, since 1941,
but according to Russian Migrants' Committee he arrived
here on 24.I.43.

SUBJECT:
Dolgoff V.S. not registered at the Russian
Migrants' Committee in Shanghai at all, but his son
Valentine Dolgoff (born in 1922) residing in Shanghai at
82 Rte des Soeurs, registered with the local Russian Mig-
rants' Committee. It is unknown what kind of documents
has N.S. & V.S. Dolgoff, but apparently they both in
possession of documents issued by Japanese Authorities in
Japan.

SEDIAKIN Nikolai Vasilievich, Russian Mig-
rant, single, born on 17.2.1915 in Vladivostok-Siberia.
He was residing in Harbin 1919-1929. In 1929
he proceeded in Japan, where he stayed until 1937 and
there received his education (in Kobe).
In 1937 he arrived in Shanghai, and here
worked as book-keeper at China Realty Co., and mostly
worked as broker. He made several trips to Japan and last
time arrived in Shanghai from Kobe on 22.II.41 and took
up residence at 97/207-A, Rte Vallon, but on 17.IX.43,
removed to 59 Rte de Boisson and according to Pao-Chia
registration still residing there. He registered with
the local Russian Migrants' Committee, but his documents
not in order. N.V.Sediakin was charged with Misappropriat
ion and was brought before Ist.C.S.D.Court and sentenced
to 8 months imprisonment, suspended for 3 years, 27.7.38.

N. Kochetov
D.S.I.

Date 16/5/1944

SUBJECT: Re: Gambling at 97/207 Route Vallon.

On 2I october I943, information was received
by the undersigned concerning a gambling house
that was functioning at the apartment 207 house
97 Route Vallon. According to the informer about
30-40 persons, most of them jews, were meeting at
the above mentioned gambling at night, 3 or 4 times
a week. The owner of the house is Mr.Nicolas S.
DOLGOFF, Russian emigrant, ( R.C. N°C 5266 A ). A
certain Russian emigrant Nicolas V.SEDIAKIN is
also living in the same apartment to-gether with
the nephew of N.Dolgoff recently arrived from
Japan.
The apartment have one front door and one
back door communicating with a separate exit throu-
ghout a common balcony and a back-yard. In order
to prevent a raid of the Police Mr. Dolgoff is
employing special night watchman - a russian Peter
MALINOWSKY whose duty consist in whistling in case
of "danger".
According to the undersigned's informer Mr.
N.DOLGOFF has a partner, this partner is one Ja-
panese named SAKADA (?) from the "Dollar Trading
Co" situated in Hardoon Building, Nanking Road. This
Japanese sometimes is assisting the gambling. Some
rumors are saying that Mr.Dolgoff is closely con-
nected with the Ist Police Bureau.
The visitors of this gambling house are playing
only cards.
The telephone number of the house is - 77940.
